observations: Photo 0: motorcycle instrument cluster with two analog gauges, mirror, ignition switch, handlebar controls, set against a rough concrete wall.
Photo 1: fuel tank with partial lettering 'Kawasa...' embossed/painted on it, black seat, visible grime and corrosion near the tank seam and wall base.
Photo 2: rear wheel with red-rimmed alloy rim, disc brake rotor, exhaust pipe showing surface rust/discoloration, orange turn signal lens, bike resting on a concrete surface.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 confirms 'Kawasaki' branding on tank, but no 'ZZR' model marking is visible in any photo; model name is only in seller's text.
No video or audio of the engine running, no photo of odometer reading clearly, no test ride possible remotely.
No photo or document supports or contradicts this reason for sale.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run properly despite 'working fine' claim.
risks.proof: Video clip of engine starting, idling, and revving.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / non-functional engine

risks.risk: True mileage/odometer reading unclear due to gauge glare in photo 0.
risks.proof: Close-up clear photo of odometer digits.

risks.risk: Frame, exhaust, and tank show rust and grime, possible deeper corrosion or past accident damage not visible.
risks.proof: Wide shots of both sides of the bike and underside of frame in good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily worn with cosmetic and possible structural wear

risks.risk: No proof of ownership/registration papers, relevant for resale and legal transfer in Abuja.
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle particulars/registration document matching chassis number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unregistered/unverified ownership, higher risk

risks.risk: Tire and brake condition only partially visible; rear tire tread looks worn in photo 2.
risks.proof: Close-up of tread depth on both tires and brake pad thickness.

proof_requests: Video of engine starting and running, with sound.
Clear photo of odometer/instrument cluster without glare.
Photo of chassis/engine number and matching registration papers.
Full side-profile photos of both left and right sides of the bike in daylight.
Close-up of tire tread and brake pads.
response.reason: Brand (Kawasaki) is confirmed from photo 1 and the item is clearly a sport motorcycle, but the ZZR model, running condition, mileage, and ownership documents are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
